Our story

Strong is built one heavy rep at a time.

Heavy iron, expert coaches and a floor built for serious progress. All you have to do is show up.

Coach on the floor
Our promise

Coaching first. Always.

Iron Pulse is for first-timers and seasoned lifters alike. A coach on the floor to fix form and push you, and a plan built for you, not a template.

  • We learn your goals, history and limits first
  • A training plan built around you
  • A coach on the floor, every session
  • We review your numbers and adjust the plan

FAQ

Before you ask.

What does the free week include?

Walk in, meet a coach and train on the full floor. No payment needed to start.

Which package should I choose?

Starter gives 3 months of full floor access. Elite is 12 months with a personalised plan and nutrition guidance. Signature adds one-to-one coaching.

Do I need experience?

No. Iron Pulse is for first-timers and seasoned lifters alike, and a coach on the floor will help with form.
